description: Controlled stationary player target and frozen regular subject update; actual think and navigation-link methods called unchanged at delta 0.05. 30-degree target offset verified at the update. Client render time and native recording-frame timing link each trimmed clip. Rendered root yaw is retained and is not assumed equal to authoritative body yaw; captions are SERVER measurements. Each part shows real time then quarter speed; aim first, link second. Original drifting-target baseline captures are superseded and retained locally.
